$comment: Single source of truth for the C++ renderer build. Read by scripts/build-cpp.mjs, cpp/CMakeLists.txt, tests/cpp-build-config.test.ts and scripts/cpp-size-report.mjs. Paths are relative to cpp/. Never hand-copy a flag, export or source list into either build script.

compile.$comment: language flags change the emitted code; warning flags never do (so -Werror under CI=1 is not recorded in build-info.json).

optionalFlags.$comment: Opt-in release experiments, enabled by the named env var (=1). Off by default until a browser matrix confirms them; see cpp/README.md.

webgpuPorts.$comment: WebGPU port rungs. build-cpp.mjs walks them as a ladder (TETRIS_CPP_WEBGPU); CMake's `auto` is the first rung only (emdawn) and fails rather than degrade. Flags are shared, so a given rung produces the same command line either way.

exports.$comment: loader: every name CppRendererLoader.ts cwrap()s or reads as module._name — tests/cpp-build-config.test.ts fails if this list and the loader differ. extra: exported C++ API that the TS side deliberately does not call (documented in cpp/README.md); the test pins it to the EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE set.
